limitations_of_this_research: HLTV pages were read through egress that reaches hltv.org; the automation runner still receives HTTP 403 (Cloudflare) for the same URLs, so HLTV cannot be a machine-read price source for the four-hour pipeline regardless of what its pages show.

HLTV rank badges were recorded only where they appeared in the page segment read; missing ranks are null, not inferred. The pipeline's dated HLTV-ranking rung reads the full official weekly ranking page itself.

Exchange/order-book states are observations at 2026-10-23T09:44Z-09:53Z; books can form or tighten at any time before each start. The dated runner record (line-source-research.json) and the four-hour refresh are the repeating instruments.

Bookmaker HTML boards (GG.BET, Rivalry, Bet365, etc.) answer the runner with challenges or 4xx/5xx (recorded verbatim in the runner sweep); a blocked page is a limitation, not proof that no market exists anywhere.
